properties.notes: W/17/1700 - Full planning application including means of access, appearance, landscaping, layout and scale, for the demolition of Covent Garden Multi-Storey car park and pedestrian footbridge, and the erection of mixed use buildings comprising new 2,685m2 (GIA) offices (use class B1) over four floors including plant room; a new multi-storey car park over four floors, comprising 617 car park spaces and 3 external spaces, 20 motor cycle spaces and 30 cycle spaces; and 44 residential units (use class C3) with 44 cycle spaces for the apartments.
